Compilation succeeded and all test cases produce correct results:

| Input | Result | Verification |
|---|---|---|
| empty | `0 0 0 0` | 0 of everything |
| `hello world\n` | `1 2 12 11` | 1 line, 2 words, 12 bytes, longest 11 |
| `a b\nc d e\n` | `2 5 10 5` | 2 lines, 5 words, 10 bytes, "c d e" = 5 |
| no trailing newline | `1 5 22 17` | handles partial last line in maxlen |
| `\n\n` | `2 0 2 0` | empty lines count as 0-length |
| `line1\r\nwin\r\n` | `2 2 12 6` | \r counted as byte for maxlen (6 = "line1\r") |
